C0930.title: Ping An Bank Credit Card Assists Police in Dismantling a 'Proxy Rights Protection' Black Market Gang
C0930.summary: In August 2023, the gang led by Li XX was sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment ranging from three years to four years and six months for extortion, with illegal gains recovered, fines imposed, and compensation paid to the victimized unit for economic losses. The gang engaged in illegal proxy rights protection activities through methods such as malicious complaints, and was detected by Ping An Bank
